_notes: Accessibility statement (WCAG 2.2 AA target, followed by choice). The display settings section documents the header toggles (CONTRACT section 8: accessible names "Dark theme" and "Animations", dark by default, choices kept in localStorage) and the quote builder fallbacks (CONTRACT section 6, quote.json v3). Claims describe how the site is built and checked; owner to confirm the contact route before launch.

seo.title: Accessibility Statement | RNC Landscaping
seo.description: RNC Landscaping aims to meet WCAG 2.2 Level AA on this website. Learn what we have done, known limits, and how to report an accessibility problem to us.

lede: We want everyone to be able to use this website, including people who use assistive technology.

sections.heading: Our target
body: We aim to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA. We follow them by choice, and we treat anything that falls short as a problem to fix.

sections.heading: Display settings
body: Two buttons in the header change how the site looks. Your browser remembers each choice on this device, so the next page you open looks the same.

items.title: Dark theme
items.body: The site opens in a dark theme. Press Dark theme to switch to the light theme, and press it again to switch back.

items.title: Animations
items.body: Some illustrations drift slowly in the background. If your device is set to reduce motion, they start switched off. Press Animations to turn them on or off at any time; with animations off, nothing on the page moves by itself.

items.title: Without JavaScript
items.body: Pages and the quote form still work. The two buttons are hidden, the site uses the dark theme and nothing moves.

items.title: Contrast
items.body: Text, controls and focus outlines are checked against WCAG AA contrast ratios in both the dark and the light theme.

items.title: Keyboard
items.body: Links, menus, buttons and form fields work with a keyboard, with a visible focus outline.

items.title: Forms
items.body: Every quote form field has a label, and help text where it is needed. If something is missing, a list of errors appears at the top of the form and each message sits next to its field. What you typed is kept.

items.title: If your email app does not open
items.body: The quote form shows your request on the page so you can copy it, and offers other ways to reach us.

items.title: Zoom and small screens
items.body: Pages are built to reflow on narrow screens and at 200% zoom, without scrolling sideways to read.

sections.heading: Known limits
body: Some linked government pages and PDF documents are outside our control and may not meet the same standard.
Automated checks do not find every problem. If you meet one, please tell us.

sections.heading: Report a problem
body: If something doesn't work for you, contact us at [EMAIL] or [PHONE]. Tell us the page and what happened, and we'll work on a fix or give you the information another way.
